Subject: Request: Open Senior Oncall Engineer (Inference) - approval to proceed

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

We need approval to open a backfill req for a Senior Oncall Engineer (Inference) — Gavin is transitioning to a product role and we want to replace the seat on the oncall rota. This is a headcount-neutral backfill (same level and band), we have budgeted for the replacement under team code INF-OPS-2. Key ask: greenlight to open the requisition in Workday and start scheduling interviews.

Why now:
- Gavin's last day on rotation is 2026-04-16; ideal candidate should start ramping by 2026-05-01.
- Oncall coverage is tight for the next two quarters; we should not leave the slot vacant.

Proposed details (attached):
- Role: Senior Oncall Engineer (Inference) — 4+ years infra/serving experience, LLM infra familiarity preferred.
- Interview panel: Dev (tech lead), Hannah (hiring manager), Jasmine (recruiter coordinated panel), Marissa to approve compensation.
- Timeline: Open req this week, screen next week, onsite/loop week of 4/5.

Attached: jd_senior-oncall.pdf and candidate_resume_priya_menon.pdf (internal referral). Priya Menon is an internal referral from Brandon at Acme AI — strong SRE background with inference experience. I recommend we fast-track Priya through the panel; she is available for interviews starting 3/22.

If you can confirm level (senior) and approve headcount open, I will hand off to Jasmine to create the req and calendar the panel.

Thanks,
Hannah
